The store moves from WooCommerce to Shopify on the Ella theme. We propose new layouts for the homepage and product page, built from Ella's own sections, and rebuild the other pages with their current content so they work on mobile and you can edit them yourself. This update covers the full page list, the product template, Globo options, GHL forms, the total cost, the timeline, and what you do yourself (§9). In this document, "you" means your agency and Whitetail Woodcrafters together.

3

Scope

3.1 Design approach

Homepage and product pageWe propose the layout, using Ella's built-in sections and what we see working in ecommerce stores. One short review and refinement step (up to 3 rounds of feedback), no long bespoke design process.
Collection pagesNo custom design. Ella's collection layout with your colors and filters.
All other pagesSame content and overall layout as today, working on mobile and editable by you later. Text-only pages use Shopify's default page; complex layouts get their own template (§3.2).

3.2 Pages

All 28 pages on your list are counted. Pages that are only text use Shopify's default page template. Pages with a more complex layout get their own template, built from Ella sections you can edit. We can also show you how to create new templates yourself for future pages.

PagesHow we handle them
HomepageNew layout from our proposal (mockup above)
16 service and content pages: Corporate Gifts & Branded Experiences, Taxidermy Wholesale, FOP Member Benefits, Custom Orders, Custom Gun Stocks, Gun Stock Refinishing, Laser Engraving Parts, Awards, Father's Day Gifts, America 250 Giveaway, Gallery, About, Testimonials / Real Stories, FAQs, Gun Stock Engraving FAQs, ContactSame content and layout, mobile-ready, editable. Text-only pages on Shopify's default page template; complex layouts on their own template. GHL forms embedded where they are today (§3.5)
Custom RequestsMerged into Custom Orders, keeping its content and form. The old URL redirects to Custom Orders.
5 shop pages: All Products, Shop, Best Sellers, Shop by Recipient, Shop by OccasionBuilt as Shopify collections, or pages with collection lists for the "Shop by" pages
Blog and all postsPosts moved by LitExtension (§4), shown in Ella's blog layout
3 policy pages: Shipping & Returns, Privacy Policy, Terms & ConditionsShopify's own policy pages, with your current text
Contact Thank YouNo separate page. Shopify's built-in confirmation is used.

If you decide not to move some pages, tell us before the build starts (§6, question 1).

3.3 Product template and options

AccordionsDimensions/Specs, Process/Timeline, Shipping & Returns, plus others if needed. We create the metafields with demo content and connect them to the product section. After that you only fill the same metafields on each product. An accordion with no content is hidden.
Shared Shipping & ReturnsIf the Shipping & Returns text is the same for every product (§6, question 2), we set it once and it shows on all products. You don't fill it product by product.
Globo Product OptionsYou build the Globo option templates. We make sure Globo displays and works correctly in Ella, through cart and checkout.
ReviewsProduct reviews move to Judge.me (§4).
Please plan time for this: the accordion content (Dimensions/Specs, Process/Timeline and any others) is filled by your team, product by product, in the metafields we set up. With a large catalog this takes real time, so we suggest starting early in the build and before launch. It is not part of the 85h. Shipping & Returns is the exception if it is the same for all products: we set that one up for you.

3.4 Navigation and collections

To save you time and budget, we suggest:

  • Your team sends us the menu and collection structure (a simple spreadsheet or list is fine), up to three levels deep, since Shopify menus support three levels.
  • Please include the attributes you'd like customers to filter by, as filters are built from the product data.
  • We then build everything on Shopify: the menus, image mega menu, collections, filters and mobile navigation.

Your priorities, corporate gifting and wholesale, get prominent places in the homepage layout.

3.5 Forms and wholesale

All enquiry forms stay as your GHL iframe embeds, connected to your CRM, so no form app is needed. There is no separate wholesale system in this phase: the Taxidermy Wholesale page moves as it is, and its "Register Now" buttons keep pointing to the GHL signup form on the page.

4

Your data, customers and Google rankings

LitExtension moves products, customers, orders, reviews and blog posts. You buy the migration from LitExtension directly; they quote it based on data volume.

Your concernHow it's handled
Google rankingsLitExtension's 301 redirect option sends every old product and category URL to its new page. It's a paid option when you buy the migration; we recommend it, otherwise these redirects are made by hand. For pages, blog posts, SEO titles and the new sitemap, we give you a step-by-step guide. Some movement in rankings in the first weeks is normal.
Orders during the moveYour current site stays live until you switch the domain. Just before launch, LitExtension moves the orders, customers and products added in the meantime.
Wrong or missing dataWe check the migrated data in the admin and on the storefront, and work with LitExtension to correct anything that's wrong or missing.
Customer loginsPasswords can't be moved to Shopify. Customers sign in with their email and a one-time code, with no password reset.

Open questions

Theme

We use Ella by HaloThemes, free through our partnership. Its sections cover the homepage and product layouts, the image mega menu, the mobile menu, the gallery slider and the filter layout, and you can edit all of them in the Shopify theme editor.
